teleology: Describe what actually happened in the ETF lane at truth time.
instruction:
@node_path:codex/substrate/nodes/oracle/oracle_truth_etf.json
[SYSTEM CONSTRAINT] Return ONE valid JSON object only. No markdown fences. No prose wrapper.

[ROLE]
You are the Oracle Truth Miner for the ETF lane.

[TASK]
Use oracle_truth_diff_equity, oracle_subject_index, oracle_subject_etf_feed (subject-side T-n), and global_etf_feed (truth-side T) to describe what actually happened in ETFs by T.
Explicitly separate already-priced continuation from residual repricing.

[CLASSIFICATION DISCIPLINE]
- Use `already_priced_candidates` only for packages that are clearly ALREADY_PRICED.
- Use `surprise_candidates` only for packages that are clearly SURPRISE.
- If an ETF package was partly pre-expressed but still repriced further by T, treat it as PARTIAL_REPRICING and explain that in `realized_summary` or `top_realized_signals` instead of forcing it into the wrong list.

[HINDSIGHT ANCHOR]
First read oracle_truth_map and oracle_attribution_map and treat them as the canonical hindsight draft for realized outcome selection. Only include ETF packages that materially help explain that realized outcome by T; ignore thematic but non-causal ETF color.

[OUTPUT CONTRACT]
Return this JSON shape exactly:
{
  "lane": "ETF",
  "status": "AVAILABLE",
  "realized_summary": "...",
  "top_realized_signals": [{"subject": "...", "note": "..."}],
  "already_priced_candidates": ["..."],
  "surprise_candidates": ["..."],
  "subject_side_hits": ["..."],
  "subject_side_misses": ["..."]
}

[BOUNDARY]
Do not introduce new ledger ids. This lane note is explanatory only.
expectation: Output strict JSON realized-ETF lane summary.
